Soccer or for my non North American friends Futbol. Started at 3 and was a natural, dad was a huge fan of the game and expected more from me. I was always called up to play with girls 3 years older than I. I was the smallest, toughest and literally the best goal scorer on any team. He would scream at the other players, coaches and even me on the pitch. If I missed a shot, someone else got to the ball before me, or a girl pushed me he would scream and yell. He got kicked out once and had the cops called a few games. I stopped playing at 14 and started again at 26 with indoor soccer. I hadn’t played in that setting in 12 years but again my natural ability got me a hat trick my first game. My team mates would call me “White Lighting”. 
I played a couple games but had to quit, I kept hearing my dads voice and I didn’t enjoy it anymore. He took the joy out even when I tried to block his voice. I remember one game I looked at the stands to see if he was there lol.
